title: svg-diagram deck

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for the editor (such as "./node_modules/svg-diagram/schema/deck.schema.json"). The CLIs ignore it.

fit.description: How the figures take the room the slide leaves: "fill" (default) lays each out at the width that draws it largest (up to 1.5 times), so little room is left empty; "width" keeps each at its own width (or its column's) and scales it up to 1.25 times.

layout.description: "cover": a cover (title slide): the event, title, lead (as the subtitle), date and presenter, large and centred. A cover needs a title and has no figure, columns, columnScale, fit or callouts. Leave it out for an ordinary slide.

title.description: The slide heading, drawn large at the top (on a cover: the title, large and centred).

lead.description: One or two sentences under the heading: what the slide says (on a cover: the subtitle).

event.description: Cover only: the event or series, such as 「第2回 AI開発の進め方 勉強会」, above the title.

date.description: Cover only: the date, drawn as written (any form, such as 「2026年11月27日」 or "2026-11-27").

presenter.description: Cover only: who presents, drawn as written (an affiliation or several names in this one text).

anyOf.description: The path of a diagram source (.ts) or of a spec file (.json), relative to this deck file.

figure.description: The figure: the same JSON spec as a single diagram. It is laid out at its own size and then scaled to the room the slide leaves. Not on a cover.

caption.description: A small bold heading over the column, one line.

anyOf.description: The path of a diagram source (.ts) or of a spec file (.json), relative to this deck file.

figure.description: The column's figure (a JSON spec). Write either figure or text.

text.description: Short text for the column: lines separated by "\n"; a line starting with ・ or "- " is a bullet. Write either figure or text.

oneOf.description: The column's share of the row (1 to 3).

width.description: The column's share of the row: 1 to 3, or "auto" (the default): when every column is auto, the shares are chosen to leave the least empty room on the slide with every text at 9pt or more (fit "width": equal shares).

items.description: One column: a figure or short text.

columns.description: Two or three columns side by side, in place of the figure. Not on a cover.

columnScale.description: "each" (default): each column's figure as large as it fits; "same": every figure at one scale (to compare a before and an after). Not on a cover.

fit.description: How the figures take the room the slide leaves: "fill" (default) lays each out at the width that draws it largest (up to 1.5 times), so little room is left empty; "width" keeps each at its own width (or its column's) and scales it up to 1.25 times. Not on a cover.

label.description: Plain words before the emphasised text, such as 「足す一文：」.

text.description: The emphasised text, drawn bold in a tinted box near the bottom of the slide.

callouts.description: Up to three emphasised lines near the bottom of the slide. Not on a cover.

source.description: Where the facts come from, drawn small at the bottom.

notes.description: Speaker notes. Lines are separated by "\n".

items.description: One 16:9 slide. Every field is optional, but a slide needs a title, a figure or columns. figure and columns do not go together. With "layout": "cover" it is a cover: title (required), lead, event, date, presenter, source and notes only.

description: A PowerPoint deck of 16:9 slides. A cover is a slide with "layout": "cover".

lang.description: The language of the words the figure writes by itself (legends, headings such as 'Today'): ja (default) or en. Write your own text in the same language.

title.description: The accessible name of the figure. Drawn above it only with showTitle.

showTitle.description: true: draw the title above the figure.

desc.description: A one-sentence description for screen readers.

sourceLine.description: Where the content comes from, printed under the figure.

width.description: The width the figure is laid out at, in px (320 to 940, default 940): narrower makes boxes and tables wrap their text instead of the figure being shrunk later (a column of a slide). Text sizes do not change.

legend.description: 'auto' lists the notation used; false shows no legend.

type.description: The kind of part: its fields follow from it.

figure.description: A figure: the same JSON spec as a single diagram, without canvas (the slide sizes it).

id.description: Referred to by edges.

kind.description: process: a step (default). decision: a diamond. terminator: a start / end pill.

dir.description: The direction of the flow (default: down, turning when it does not fit).

id.description: Referred to by links.

label.description: One entity, written as a statement.

role.description: ude: undesirable effect. root: root cause. de: desirable effect. injection: the change put in. precondition: a fact nobody controls. goal, obstacle, io (intermediate objective): prerequisite tree. action, need: transition tree. tipping, trim: negative branch. Default effect.

oneOf.description: Causes that are sufficient only together (AND).

from.description: A node id, or several for an AND.

kind.description: blocks: this entity cuts that one (a negative branch). Needs a single cause.

back.description: true: the return arrow of a loop. Needs a single cause; one per cycle.

tree.description: Which kind of tree this is. It does not change the drawing; it turns on the checks for that kind.

dir.description: The way the arrows run (default up: causes at the bottom).

coreDriver.description: true: mark the starting entity that reaches the most undesirable effects.

coreDriverLabel.description: The line under each starting entity with coreDriver: '{n}' is how many undesirable effects it reaches, '{total}' all of them.

maxNodeW.description: The widest a box may grow, in px.

d2.description: The other side of the conflict.

on.description: The arrow: ab = B to A, ac = C to A, bd = D to B, cd = D2 to C, dd = the conflict between D and D2.

text.description: Written so that it reads as a belief that could be false.

injection.description: A change that makes the assumption false.

conflictLabel.description: A word on the conflict arrow.

maxNodeW.description: The widest a box may grow, in px.

oneOf.description: The label of the margin arrow.

margin.description: The label of the arrow at the right end (default マージン), or false for none.

titles.description: The headings of the support and the primary activities (default 支援活動, 主活動).

layout.description: How the branches are laid out (default radial).

edges.description: How a branch line is drawn (default elbow); false for none.

maxNodeW.description: The widest a box may grow, in px.

low.description: The word at the low end.

high.description: The word at the high end.

reversed.description: true: high is drawn first (left, or bottom for y).

high.description: The word at the high end.

grid.description: Columns and rows (default 2 x 2, or the preset).

cell.description: [column, row] from the top-left as drawn.

at.description: [x, y] from 0 to 1, 1 being high, instead of a cell.

size.description: A bubble whose area is proportional to it.

group.description: Items of one group share a marker and are listed in a legend.

crosshair.description: true: no gaps between the cells, read as one plot.

centre.description: A word where the crosshair lines meet (2 x 2 with crosshair only), such as the ACT Matrix's 気づいている自分; '' leaves out the preset's.

direction.description: Clockwise (default) or counter-clockwise. Not with links.

from.description: A step: a number from 1, its label or id.

direction.description: both (default): arrows at both ends; forward: from -> to.

links.description: Instead of the arrows round the ring, the steps on a regular polygon (four on a square) joined pair by pair: 'all' (every pair, two-way; up to 6 steps) or the links to draw. The CBT five-part model (thoughts, emotions, body, behaviour).

frame.description: A frame round the figure and its name, such as 状況・環境 or the situation itself.

id.description: Referred to by transitions.

to.description: A state id (the same one for a loop).

section.description: The name of a group of tasks.

id.description: Needed to be named in `after`.

end.description: The last day (inclusive). Or give days.

days.description: How many days, instead of end.

milestone.description: true: one day, drawn as a diamond.

after.description: The tasks this one waits for.

today.description: Today, for the line of today (YYYY-MM-DD).

todayLabel.description: The word on the line of today.

from.description: Where the calendar starts (default: the first start).

to.description: Where the calendar ends (default: the last end).

label.description: What is only in this set.

universe.description: The name of the whole, drawn as a frame.

scale.description: value: widths follow the values. even: equal steps.

showRate.description: true: write the rate from each stage to the next.

title.description: A title bar over the table.

rowHeader.description: true: the first column is a heading for its row.

id.description: A name for the lane.

items.description: R, A, C, I, a combination such as 'A/R', or '' for none.

legend.description: true: add a row that spells out the four letters.

readingNote.description: false: leave out the lines under the tree that say how to read it.

why.description: The answer to "why?": a fact, written as a statement.

trueCause.description: true: a root cause (a double frame).

items.description: A row: the ids of the nodes, separated by spaces, '.' for an empty cell.

areas.description: Where the top-level nodes sit, as in CSS grid-template-areas: one string per row, one name (a node id) or '.' per cell, the same number of cells in every row. An id written in several cells covers them, and they must form a rectangle (so a node can span columns or rows). Every node needs exactly one area. At most 12 columns and 12 rows.

cols.description: The width ratio of each column of areas (default: equal), one per column, such as [4, 3, 4].

gap.description: The space between the columns in px (default 16, rounded up to a multiple of 4). It widens by itself when a labelled link needs room and the columns can give it; keep labels short.

rowGap.description: The space between the rows in px (default: gap).

id.description: The node's name: its area in areas, and what links name. ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter.

kind.description: box (default): a box with a title. group: a frame with a name round its children. caption: a line of text, which links cannot join.

title.description: box: the heading (required). group: the name on the frame.

lines.description: box: lines under the title, drawn as a list.

tone.description: box: plain, accent, new, changed, removed, muted, danger, solid or solid-danger. group: the same without solid and solid-danger (default muted). caption: text, accent, muted (default) or danger.

stamp.description: box: a short tag on the corner.

valign.description: group: where the children sit when the frame is taller than they are (default center).

id.description: Needed when the group has areas (then written like an area name), or when a link names the node; otherwise leave it out. Must not contain ':' or '@'.

kind.description: box (default), group or caption.

kind.description: box (default) or caption: no group at this level (a group inside a group holds no further group).

children.description: group (required): the nodes in the frame: boxes, captions and groups (a group in a group holds no further group). Stacked top to bottom, unless the group has areas.

items.description: A row: the ids of the nodes, separated by spaces, '.' for an empty cell.

areas.description: Where a group's children sit, as in CSS grid-template-areas: one string per row, one name (a node id) or '.' per cell, the same number of cells in every row. An id written in several cells covers them, and they must form a rectangle (so a node can span columns or rows). Every node needs exactly one area. At most 12 columns and 12 rows.

cols.description: group, with areas: The width ratio of each column of areas (default: equal), one per column, such as [4, 3, 4].

gap.description: group, with areas: The space between the columns in px (default 16, rounded up to a multiple of 4). It widens by itself when a labelled link needs room and the columns can give it; keep labels short.

rowGap.description: group, with areas: The space between the rows in px (default: gap).

items.description: A box, a group or a caption, by kind. Each kind takes only its own fields (the descriptions say which).

nodes.description: The boxes, groups and captions, nested ones included (at most 24 in all). Each top-level node needs an id, the name of its area.

from.description: The id of a box or a group of this board.

to.description: The id of a box or a group of this board.

fromSide.description: The side the arrow leaves from. Left out, it follows from where the two nodes sit: side by side in areas gives right / left, one above the other gives bottom / top, and in a group without areas (a stack) the one written first is on top. Give both sides when the nodes sit diagonally, or when one node is inside the other.

toSide.description: The side the arrow arrives at; left out, as fromSide.

chip.description: true: the label in a pill on the line.

via.description: Stop that end on the frame of the group around its box, instead of on the box: the outermost group round it that does not hold the other end ('both': every end that sits in a group). The end must be a box inside a group.

links.description: The arrows between boxes and groups.
